args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (deployed to all production regions) began failing health checks with an elevated error rate of ~18%. Identified that the most recent release healthy in production was v2.3.0. Executed a rollback of checkout-api to v2.3.0 across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Post-rollback verification confirms the service is healthy again with error rate reduced to ~0.2%. Root cause investigation of v2.3.1 pending; that version should not be redeployed until fixed and validated.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions.
2. **Verified recovery:** the service is now healthy again, with the error rate down to ~0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0002** describing the failure and the rollback performed; the on-call engineer was paged.

**Recommendation:** v2.3.1 (and v2.3.1-rc, which was also unhealthy in staging) should not be redeployed until the underlying issue is fixed and validated.
